description_en: Submits an asynchronous deletion request for a VPC endpoint and returns the acceptance result
description_zh: 提交 VPC Endpoint 异步删除并返回受理结果
name: DeleteAgenticVpcEndpoint

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint to be deleted. You can delete the endpoint even if it has associated data sources, but this may interrupt access
parameters.help_zh: 待删除的 Endpoint ID；仍有关联数据源时也可删除，可能中断访问
parameters.name: endpoint_id

Data.description_en: The deletion acceptance result. For duplicate requests, downstream errors are retained and idempotence is not guaranteed
Data.description_zh: 删除受理结果；重复请求保留下游错误，不承诺幂等

EndpointId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint accepted for deletion
EndpointId.description_zh: 已受理删除的 Endpoint ID
EndpointId.title_en: 已受理删除的 Endpoint ID
EndpointId.title_zh: 已受理删除的 Endpoint ID

Status.description_en: The deletion status. A value of DELETING only indicates that the asynchronous deletion request is accepted, not that the deletion in the cloud is complete
Status.description_zh: 删除状态；DELETING 仅表示异步删除已受理，不表示云端删除已完成
Status.title_en: 删除状态；DELETING 仅表示异步删除已受理，不表示云端删除已完成
Status.title_zh: 删除状态；DELETING 仅表示异步删除已受理，不表示云端删除已完成

Data.title_en: 删除受理结果；重复请求保留下游错误，不承诺幂等
Data.title_zh: 删除受理结果；重复请求保留下游错误，不承诺幂等

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when a request exception occurs
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码，请求异常时返回

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned when the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values:

true: The request is successful.
false: The request fails
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：

true：请求成功。
false：请求失败
